issues.title: Missing Verifies clauses for Phase 07-21
issues.why: While AC-01 to AC-08 have Verifies clauses, the architectural invariants for Phases 07 through 21 (referenced in the overview) lack explicit GWT criteria and Verifies bindings in the §97 file.
issues.fix: Extend the AC-10 table in 97-acceptance-criteria.md to include rows for Phases 07-21 with specific architectural bindings.

issues.title: Unresolved internal sub-file references
issues.why: The overview references 22 phases, but the provided context only includes files for Phases 00, 01, and 02. A mediocre coder cannot implement the 'Gold Standard' without the content of Phases 03-21.
issues.fix: Provide the remaining phase files (03-21) or consolidate their core contracts into the §97 acceptance criteria.

issues.title: Filename casing mismatch in documentation
issues.why: Consistency report identifies a mismatch where 'CHANGELOG.md' is referenced but 'changelog.md' exists on disk, potentially breaking CI on Linux.
issues.fix: Run a global search-replace for 'CHANGELOG.md' to 'changelog.md' across all .md files.
